all.text: Nazir inherits the throne at twenty after his father and grandfather kill each other, and as a cruel Felonarch he tries to reach Inys Haen but must turn back when his birthmark burns badly.
His soldiers raid Inys Haen and return with Aylith but not the Keeper alive, and Nazir interrogates and enchants Aylith to extract the Memories of the Clan Tree.
Facing rebellion, he strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer, and Feryar carries her away, after which Nazir abandons his fortress and assaults Inys Haen, with Aylith pursuing him.
Captured, Nazir is healed of his madness and addiction by Aylith's choice, and he assists the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending his reign.
